mapper.sql: SELECT partner_role_id AS partnerRoleId, local_partner_id AS localPartnerId, role_code AS roleCode, status AS status, active_slot AS activeSlot, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM t_partner_role
mapper.select: WHERE active_slot = 1 AND local_partner_id IN (SELECT source_partner_id FROM t_entity_source_relation WHERE entity_no IN (SELECT entity_no FROM t_client_entity_affiliation WHERE client_id = #{clientId}) AND source_type = 'PARTNER') ORDER BY local_partner_id, role_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_partner_role(partner_role_id, local_partner_id, role_code, status, active_slot, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{row.partnerRoleId}, #{row.localPartnerId}, #{row.roleCode}, #{row.status}, #{row.activeSlot}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_partner_role SET status = 'ENDED', active_slot = NULL, update_time = #{now} WHERE partner_role_id = #{partnerRoleId} AND active_slot = 1
